burrito-craft.title: Burrito Craft: Build, Explore, and Create Your Blocky World
burrito-craft.slogan: Forge Your Path in a Unique Sandbox Adventure
burrito-craft.description: In Burrito Craft, the blocky world is your canvas. Build, explore, or unwind - the choice is yours! Start with simple projects and gradually build your own empire. Choose from familiar characters and dive into creative or survival gameplay. Burrito Craft offers endless possibilities for discovery and creation. Begin your adventure today!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Burrito Craft: Build, Explore, and Create
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Burrito Craft is a unique combination of Minecraft with the addition of familiar characters from Five Nights at Winstons. With constructive and creative gameplay, the signature sandbox world welcomes you with endless experiences. There are no limits to your discoveries and creations.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Move the mouse to look around and use the arrow keys to move.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Left-click to break a block and right-click to add items or objects.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Press the E key to open the inventory and select items to use.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Freely express your creativity in this blocky world.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Protect your in-game territory in a battle of survival.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Use a variety of materials to create projects with different structures.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Choose from creative or survival modes for unique journeys.
